Epistemic Rule: Proximity alone never proves causation. Every link distinguishes Observed Congestion, Spatial Association, Modelled HGV/Trip Impact, and Confirmed RTA Roadwork Impact.

Click Any Project Marker, Road Segment, or Intersection on the Map

Selecting a project opens the Section C3 Project Detail Panel (status, timeline, GFA, connected roads, geodesic distance, modelled HGV trips, and supporting Task 1 documents). Selecting a road opens the Section C4 Road Detail Panel (published speed limit, lanes, RTA vs. HCM capacity, HGV ban windows, and Morning/Midday/Evening/Night traffic observations).

Deterministic Database Q&A Interface (Work Package F)

Queries execute deterministically against the normalized Task 1 + Task 2 relational tables and automatically pan/zoom the map to the matched projects and road corridors.

1. Dataset Identifier Range Reconciliation (`15` through `22` = 11 Distinct Datasets + 18-Table Spatial SQLite DB)

Why do identifiers 15 through 22 (8 root numbers) yield 11 new CSV/JSON datasets? Because identifier 21 (the Spatial Database package) is normalized into 4 distinct spatial entity datasets (21a, 21b, 21c, 21d) plus the 7 single-numbered datasets (15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 22) = 11 datasets (144 rows), all compiled into 21_task2_spatial_database.sqlite (18 tables) and 11_consolidated_database.sqlite (29 tables, 1,465 total rows).

2. Technical Architecture, Epistemic Methodology & Community Digital Twin Roadmap (Sections 11, 16 & 17)

Data Pipeline & Spatial Reference Architecture: Task 1 Validated Repository (85 projects, 205 documents, 432 sources) → Normalized Relational & Spatial Store (21_task2_spatial_database.sqlite / PostGIS-ready schema + dubai_sharjah_gis_bundle.geojson in WGS84 EPSG:4326 with geodesic/UTM Zone 40N EPSG:32640 distance math) → Deterministic Spatial & Temporal Query Engine → Interactive 11-Layer Geospatial Map + Map-Linked Q&A Layer.

Strict Epistemic Guardrails (Zero Fabricated Causality & Missing Data vs. Zero Congestion): Every road capacity separates PUBLISHED_OFFICIAL (RTA statutory corridor capacities) from HCM_7TH_EDITION_ESTIMATE. Whenever a corridor does not have a published observation for a selected time window (e.g., off-peak Midday or Night on peak-only open-data segments), it is rendered in dashed slate-grey (Data Unavailable for Selected Window) and never conflated with free-flow/zero congestion (green).
